news_analysis.headline_hook: ₹6.80 Crore, 12 Mule Arrests, Zero Physical Assets: The Unit Economics of Corporate Identity Theft
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Authorities have made the 12th arrest in a financial fraud syndicate that utilized shell companies, fake directors, and mule bank accounts to siphon Rs 6.80 crore.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume that because the police are making arrests, the banking system is effectively purging these threats and their money is safe in regulated accounts.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: The institutional reality is that 'mule' accounts are a systemic liquidity leak; the Rs 6.80 crore is merely the tip of the iceberg in a high-velocity money laundering network that exploits the lag between digital KYC onboarding and real-time transaction monitoring.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never link your primary savings account to third-party trading platforms; use a dedicated, low-balance 'trading-only' account to isolate your core capital from potential systemic breaches.

slides.title: Arrests don't mean your capital is safe

comparison_data.myth: Police arrests in fake director scams mean the banking system is actively recovering retail funds.
comparison_data.reality: Siphoned capital moves through 10+ layered mule accounts within minutes, exploiting digital KYC latency before freeze orders land.

slides.title: The true scale of synthetic identities

stat_data.label: siphoned via 12-mule network
stat_data.context: A single syndicate utilized fake directors and shell bank accounts to instantly drain capital. By the time law enforcement acts, account balances are routinely zeroed out.

slides.title: How illicit capital bypasses detection
flowchart_data: 1. Synthetic Onboarding: Dummy directors open shell corporate accounts using bulk-procured SIM cards.
2. Layered Routing: Siphoned retail funds pass through multi-tier mule accounts in under 180 seconds.
3. Capital Liquidation: Funds are converted into untraceable assets before bank AML flags trigger.

slides.title: The cost of KYC verification lag
slides.card_text: Digital onboarding systems prioritize rapid customer acquisition over real-time transaction monitoring. Syndicate networks exploit this 48-hour verification gap to run massive volume through shell director profiles before compliance filters freeze compromised channels.

slides.title: The Non-Negotiable Firewall Rule
slides.card_text: Never link primary savings or wealth accounts to third-party brokers or unverified payment gateways. Maintain a dedicated, low-balance sub-account exclusively for trading liquidity to ring-fence your core wealth from systemic banking vulnerabilities.

checklist_data.text: Primary bank account directly linked to third-party trading portals
Isolated secondary account used exclusively for trading settlements
Automated daily transaction caps enforced on trading accounts
